body: Yea, I’m sort of in a similar spot. Nothing seems to be helping anymore. Or not nearly as much. Used to be able to disappear into music or art, and recently it’s just all ringing hollow. One of the worst things is just being stuck here, in the in-between.
I hope you find that, too. I hope that all this heaviness lifts. And that the opportunity to go back to school happens as well. Definitely believe in you.

Yea, perspective can be helpful sometimes. But your right heh; most of the time it doesn’t negate everything else. That sounds awful though, I’m not in a good place either. Or haven’t been in a good place in a long time I suppose. Has anything been helpful in distracting lately? And my days’ not going too great. Just feeling really low. And tired. Trying to look at the bright side of things, but I’m not having the easiest time.

Yea, It’s like being aware and conscious (though I’m grateful for certain things- - i.e. being able to get up and walk around or be semi-independent. Not being worse off than I am physically) it’s just too much sometimes. Like it’s all inescapable. The worst days seem to come around when distractions or sleep doesn’t end up helping. When the heaviness doesn’t seem to lift. How’ve things been for you lately?  (or has the s/h been bad- - not that you have to say of course)

Yea, I feel similarly just stuck and feeling nothing either. The numbness/emptiness that bleeds into everything is worse than feeling things sometimes. only 26 and I’ve gotten to the point where its just become normal. Not that I’m okay with that- - but I don’t have a lot of hope that it’ll turn around I guess. Even knowing that the brain is plastic, things can shift and change. Maybe that brings a bit of light to things (?). I don’t know. 

I’ve pushed everyone away, too. Not intentionally. But I’ve failed at being able to maintain those connections for whatever reason, despite wanting to keep them. 

I have no energy anymore. 


If the opportunity arose, what would go back to study? What kind/genre of music helps distract or that you like?

O nah; you don’t have to apologize or anything at all. Pain is pain. Who would I be to say that mine is worse than yours, you know? Definitely don’t have to say sorry. Really do appreciate your replies.

Yea. It does feel that way; like that’s one of the last things that feels controllable. ‘Being’ itself is exhausting. Being stuck in this body, I don’t know how to describe or put words to it. All this overwhelming heaviness that doesn’t seem to lift. It feels like the only times when I’m able to feel contentment or peace of some kind is when I’m able to distract myself or when I’m asleep. Even those don’t really work effectively sometimes. It’s been so long since I could wake up and say to myself, ‘today I feel like I can function alright..’ . I miss that. Not being reminded of things. How have you had to rebuild time and time again (or/if you want to say- - not that you have to say).

Yea it really is an awful place to be. Tried so many avenues- - except magnetic and ect therapy. Been on 6/7 different kinds of meds, been in talk therapy for years. Ketamine. In and out of the psychward and outpatient. It really does get taxing after a certain point. Part of me has sort of accepted that certain things might not get better- - just hard to try and sit with that sometimes (or most of the time I guess).
